# Gift Idea Finder Skill for Muse

A copy-paste prompt skill that finds genuinely good gifts: it profiles the recipient (interests, constraints, budget), matches ideas to the occasion, weighs experiences against objects, steers you away from generic picks, and even helps plan presentation and timing. Birthdays, holidays, weddings, host gifts — covered. Draft: Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
